serverUrl.name: LiveKit server URL
serverUrl.hint: The server's secure WebSocket address, such as wss://example.livekit.cloud. Plain ws:// works only on this computer or a private network (ws://localhost:7880 for a local test server). Every player can read this setting.

apiKey.name: LiveKit API key
apiKey.hint: Stored only in this browser. Players get short-lived tokens from a GM's browser, so players never see it.

apiSecret.name: LiveKit API secret
apiSecret.hint: Stored only in this browser and never sent to players. Enter it on each browser a GM uses to run the game.

legacy.title: Settings from LiveKit AVClient
legacy.question: This world has LiveKit server settings from LiveKit AVClient, the module Modular A/V replaces. Use them here? The address goes to the world's settings; the API key and secret are kept only in this browser.
legacy.remove: Remove LiveKit AVClient's server settings from this world? Every player's browser could read them, the secret included.
legacy.imported: Modular A/V: LiveKit now uses the server from LiveKit AVClient.
legacy.rotate: LiveKit AVClient kept the API secret where every player could read it. Create a new key and secret in your LiveKit project, enter them in Modular A/V: LiveKit's settings, and delete the old key.
legacy.tavern: LiveKit AVClient used Tavern's Patreon server here, which Modular A/V doesn't support. Set up a LiveKit server or LiveKit Cloud, or use P2P.
legacy.badAddress: LiveKit AVClient's server address couldn't be used. Enter it in Modular A/V: LiveKit's settings.
